blockers.question: What permanent app identity should the mobile app use (android.package / ios.bundleIdentifier), and should the FNB artefact be an APK or an AAB?
blockers.why_blocked: Both identifiers are permanent once published and cannot be changed later; choosing them is a founder decision, not an engineering one. No eas.json or package identifier exists, so no build can start.
options: za.co.varsitycompanion (recommended — matches the product name and the .co.za domain)
Something tied to the registered business entity
blockers.recommendation: Use za.co.varsitycompanion and build an APK for FNB judges. Judges install an app; they do not browse a store listing, so an APK removes review time and developer-account setup from the critical path.
